editorial.blurb: This hidden gem in uptown delivers fresh, high-quality sushi in a fun and adorable setting where the all-you-can-eat conveyor belt experience feels both playful and genuinely satisfying.
editorial.insiderTip: Go for the all-you-can-eat option to maximize variety—the colored plates on the belt range from $3.30 to $7.30, and ask your server (Angie or Jessica are favorites) about the punch card program where you can spin the wheel for loyalty prizes.
